info.name: Lab Report Access API - Patient, Doctor & Hospital
info.description: Complete API collection for lab report access. Patient: upload/view all reports (self + hospital), uploadedBy/uploadedByHospitalName in response. Doctor: view with permission. Hospital: list reports uploaded by hospital, upload for patient.

variable.description: Hospital patient ID (for hospital report APIs)

item.name: 👨‍⚕️ Doctor APIs

request.description:
Doctor requests all reports for a patient. Requires permission from patient.

**What Doctor Passes:**
- `patientId` in URL path (regular patient ID, not globalPatientId)
- JWT token in Authorization header

item.name: 👤 Patient APIs

request.description:
Patient grants access to a doctor or hospital to view their reports.

**Request Body Options:**
1. Grant to specific doctor: `{"doctorId": 123}`
2. Grant to hospital (all doctors): `{"hospitalId": 456}`
3. Grant to doctor in hospital: `{"doctorId": 123, "hospitalId": 456}`
4. With expiration: `{"doctorId": 123, "expiresAt": "2024-12-31T23:59:59"}`
5. With notes: `{"doctorId": 123, "notes": "For consultation"}`

response.name: ✅ Success - Permission Granted
response.body:
{
    "id": 5,
    "patientId": 789,
    "doctorId": 123,
    "doctorName": "Dr. John Smith",
    "hospitalId": null,
    "hospitalName": null,
    "isActive": true,
    "grantedAt": "2024-01-20T10:30:00",
    "expiresAt": "2024-12-31T23:59:59",
    "notes": "For consultation and follow-up"
}

request.description:
Patient revokes access permission. Doctor immediately loses access to reports.

**What Patient Passes:**
- `permissionId` in URL (get from permissions list)

response.name: ❌ Error - Not Your Permission
response.body:
{
    "timestamp": "2024-01-20T10:30:00",
    "status": 403,
    "error": "Forbidden",
    "message": "You can only revoke your own permissions",
    "path": "/api/v1/patients/lab-reports/permissions/10"
}

item.name: 🏥 Hospital APIs

request.description: Get reports for a patient uploaded by this hospital only. HOSPITAL_ADMIN/HOSPITAL_STAFF. hospitalPatientId = hospital patient ID (not global patient ID).
Upload a report for a patient (hospital staff). Report is linked to this hospital. Multipart: file, reportType, reportDate, doctorName (optional), labName (optional).

item.description: Hospital staff: list reports uploaded by this hospital for a patient, and upload new reports. Patient sees all (self + hospital) via GET /api/v1/patients/lab-reports.
